versions.changelog:
No changes detected for version 1.0.2.

- No file modifications were made in this release.
- Existing style guide and documentation remain unchanged.

- Removed references to the Airbnb JavaScript Style Guide to make the skill guide more general.
- Updated the description and activation section to reflect a broader best-practice approach.
- Streamlined the wording in style rules for improved clarity.
- No changes to code logic or behavioral features.

Initial release—introduces a comprehensive JavaScript style guide skill based on Airbnb’s JavaScript Style Guide.

- Provides best-practice JavaScript coding conventions covering variables, functions, objects, arrays, classes, modules, async patterns, error handling, naming conventions, and more.
- Generates code and explanations that strictly follow the Airbnb style guide.
- Activates when JavaScript is mentioned or implied in user requests.
- Includes detailed style rules with examples for common JavaScript scenarios.
